<!-- pr-reviewer: 75afc26f19d06abd752517a449a46d38c362f5af -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes geometry, winding checks and the slicer. It changes no UI files or goldens.

What looks good:

- The fragment rule requires one complete matching. The slicer checks every shared edge and the outward volume after the links.
- The feature graph retains all edge uses until it checks the contact.
- The new pins cover whole-face contact and line-only refusal. Both independent mutation checks fail at the intended assertions.

Results merged with main:

I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2941`. I used PR head `75afc26f19d06abd752517a449a46d38c362f5af` and main `0306743decfa53783235780eb33b578052dfd6de`. The trial merge was clean. I used no GitHub runner.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch plan. It completed 983 steps in 85.6 minutes. 982 steps passed. One step failed. All nine crate prebuilds and clippy passed.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| geometry lib | 58 passed |
| geometry feature_contact | 2 passed |
| geometry slice_bodies | 7 passed |
| app feature_edge_g1_join | 5 passed |
| app winding_align | 11 passed |
| app stitch_cross | 6 passed |
| app shared_face_bodies | 5 passed |
| UI lib | 1,285 passed; 7 ignored |
| clippy, all eight selected crates, all targets, `-D warnings` | passed |

The failed step was `app suites: stock_source_holes`: 8 tests passed and 1 failed. The failed test was `framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`. An isolated rerun failed too. It stops at `crates/app/tests/stock_source_holes_support/mod.rs:260`:

```text
generate: MachiningAt { msg: "S1: invalid machining parameters: the edge loop near X35.000 Y20.249 carries a modelled chamfer on only part of its length - it is sharp near X-35.000 Y-16.176 - a chamfer with no picks would cut the sharp part; pick the edges to break", at: Point3 { x: -18.37878528608396, y: 35.0, z: 12.379515225556053 } }
```

I restored all four changed production files to upstream main and ran this test again. It failed with the same diagnostic. Those upstream files and this test are unchanged between the tested main and current main `83c53732be0cc938929b507c93d19abc39e5d72b`. This result does not establish a regression from this PR.

Extra suites run:

The diff changes no fixture data or importer code, so neither extra selection rule adds a suite. The batch plan also ran these suites:

- kernel `step_agreement`: 22 passed.
- kernel `machining_mesh`: 7 passed.
- app `feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.

Mutations:

1. Restore the upstream feature builder. `a_whole_contact_face_keeps_each_solids_features` fails on the non-manifold edge assertion. Restore the PR builder: the test passes.
2. Restore the upstream slicer caller. `solids_sharing_a_whole_face_slice_as_one_outline` fails with `NonManifold { z: 2.5 }`. Restore the PR caller: the test passes.

I restored all files after each check. The review tree has no changes after these checks. No goldens moved, so no golden comparison was needed.

Requested before merge:

1. Run the reached heavy lanes on the final PR head. Record the command, lanes and results in the PR body. The change at `crates/geometry/src/geometry/shared_edge.rs:76` reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 229 steps. The PR body states that the heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream `AGENTS.md:601` requires these results before readiness. Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`.

Heavy lanes run: none. The dry run is a plan, not a test pass. The release lane and manual GUI use were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Run the reached heavy lanes on the final PR head and record the command, lanes and results in the PR body.

Head: `75afc26f19d06abd752517a449a46d38c362f5af` (unchanged).

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` ran the motion and app heavy lanes.
It completed 229 steps in 65.8 minutes. 228 steps passed or met their expected known-fail result.
The unexpected failure was `app pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`.
It reported the path tuple `(3158, 3130, 1141)` and arc proof refusals.
All six shared-face finish bands passed. The PR body records the results. The heavy gate is red.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch plan and passed all 972 steps in 91.5 minutes.
All nine prebuilds and the all-target clippy checks for eight crates passed.
All nine `stock_source_holes` tests passed, including `framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
The tracked files and goldens stayed unchanged.

The latest finding requested verification results only. No source change, new pin or mutation check was needed.
Please re-review the recorded results on this head.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `needs-rework` or `conflicts`: each one is repaired, reviewed and merged. This PR had a push in the last 6 hours, so the coordinator session of NeoTech does not edit its branch now. Push a refresh, or say here that you keep it. After 6 hours without a push or an answer, our session takes the PR over on this branch (a merge of `main`, never a rebase or a force-push) and repairs the open review items.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. The later `Addressed` comment permits a second review of this unchanged head.

The earlier request to run and record the reached heavy lanes is met. However, the reached heavy gate remains red.

What looks good:

- The fragment rule requires one complete matching. Slicing retains the final shared-edge and outward-volume checks.
- The feature graph retains all incident facets before it checks contact.
- Both independent mutation checks fail at the intended assertions and pass after restoration.

Results merged with main:

I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2941`. The trial merge was clean.
PR head: `75afc26f19d06abd752517a449a46d38c362f5af`.
Upstream main: `58cb641caa0a4c0b6d514c3e874ccaee1b8a6e5b`.
I used no GitHub runner.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` completed 987 steps in 55.5 minutes. It reported 986 passes and one failure.
All nine prebuilds and all-target clippy for eight crates passed with `-D warnings`.

The failed step was `ui suites: trace_parity`, with exit status `-1`. Its log ended after the first passing test without an assertion diagnostic.
I ran `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only 'ui suites: trace_parity'` again. All five tests passed.
The other steps were not repeated.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| geometry lib | 58 passed |
| geometry feature_contact | 2 passed |
| geometry slice_bodies | 7 passed |
| app feature_edge_g1_join | 5 passed |
| app winding_align | 11 passed |
| app stitch_cross | 6 passed |
| app shared_face_bodies | 5 passed; sample finish and pocket reported no gouge |
| app stock_source_holes | 9 passed |
| UI lib | 1,289 passed; 7 ignored |

Extra suites run:

The diff changes no fixture data or importer code. Neither extra selection rule adds a suite.
The quick gate's batch plan also ran:

- kernel `step_agreement`: 23 passed.
- kernel `machining_mesh`: 7 passed.
- app `feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.

Heavy lanes run:

The PR body records the author's complete motion and app heavy lanes: 229 steps, with one unexpected failure.
It reports 56 motion tests passed, two expected known failures, 40 app tests passed, and five expected known failures.
All six shared-face finish bands passed. These are the author's results, not a second complete run by this reviewer.

I independently ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: pocket3d_hsm'` on the trial merge.
The release build passed. The selected test failed at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144:5`:

```text
the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean ... FAILED
the bore's path as the fix plans it: (3158, 3130, 1141)
```

The Linux pin expects `(4726, 4698, 549)`. The notes report that some fitted arcs could not be proved inside the cutter-centre area and stayed as chords.
This reproduces the reported failure. It does not establish whether this PR caused it; I did not run an upstream-only heavy baseline.

Mutations:

1. Restore upstream's `feature.rs`. `a_whole_contact_face_keeps_each_solids_features` fails at `feature_contact.rs:24` on the non-manifold edge assertion. Restore the PR file: one test passes.
2. Restore upstream's `slice_bodies.rs`. `solids_sharing_a_whole_face_slice_as_one_outline` fails at `slice_bodies.rs:62` with `NonManifold { z: 2.5 }`. Restore the PR file: one test passes.

All temporary mutations were restored. The tracked review tree is clean. No goldens moved, so no golden comparison was needed.
The diff changes no UI files, so screenshots are not required for this PR.

Requested before merge:

1. Resolve the reached heavy-test failure at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`. Diagnose the path change and obtain a green reached heavy gate on the final head. Record the command and results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md:601-605` prevents readiness while a reached heavy test is red. The recorded run satisfies the earlier request for evidence, but its red result does not satisfy readiness.

The full release gate and manual GUI use were not exercised. The PR remains a draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
